mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dispatch_record WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM dispatch_record WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM dispatch_record WHERE dispatch_status = 'PENDING' AND DATE_ADD(dispatched_at, INTERVAL timeout_minutes MINUTE) < NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch_record (work_order_id, worker_id, crew_id, dispatch_type, dispatch_status, score, score_detail, dispatched_at, responded_at, timeout_minutes, remark) VALUES (#{workOrderId}, #{workerId}, #{crewId}, #{dispatchType}, #{dispatchStatus}, #{score}, #{scoreDetail}, #{dispatchedAt}, #{respondedAt}, #{timeoutMinutes}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dispatch_record SET dispatch_status = #{dispatchStatus}, responded_at = NOW(), remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dispatch_record SET dispatch_status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND dispatch_status = 'PENDING'
